title: Task Evaluation Configuration
description: Defines rulepack mapping, enabled rules, thresholds, and boundaries for a specific task.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the task, e.g., 'T1_auth_refactor'

rulepack_id.description: The ID of the rulepack to use for this task.

enabled.description: Subset of rules from the rulepack to enable for this task.

thresholds.description: Optional warn/fail thresholds for specific metrics. Keys must match metric rule IDs.

expected_diff_scope.description: Glob patterns defining allowed file modifications. Helps detect agent hallucinations or out-of-bounds edits.
